question.text: OPEC output decisions matter for commodity analysts because:

answer.text: OPEC countries consume most crude oil
Output changes affect global crude supply, prices, pricing power, and market stability
OPEC sets retail fuel prices in India

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.222, increased oil output by OPEC members pressures global crude prices downward, and per p.224, OPEC output agreements affect pricing power and market stability. Output decisions therefore feed directly into global supply, prices, pricing power, and market stability. The Trap: OPEC is a producer cartel; it is not a consumer group, a retail fuel-price setter in India, or a regulator of commodity exchanges. Note: The points about output-driven price pressure and pricing-power/market-stability impact are taken directly from p.222 and p.224.
